title: 4D Printers in EFL Classrooms: A Case Study at Saudi University for Revolutionary Move Toward Sustainability in Education
content: The rapid evolution of technology in recent times requires a corresponding shift in education. This shift in the education sector plays a significant role in addressing numerous contemporary issues, such as sustainability. The need for sustainable development is one of the world’s most pressing issues, touching upon every aspect of human life and implying a shared responsibility across all human populations. In education, technology use could benefit the sustainability of the educational environment and contribute to its development. For example, 4D printers have recently been introduced to build products quickly with reduced energy consumption. In the literature, the 4D printer has been proposed for use in education but is yet to be widely implemented. Both primary and secondary data were used to answer the current research questions. For the primary data, the current study therefore surveys the preferred learning style of female EFL university students in Saudi Arabia, looking at how 4D printers could be integrated into their English language classes. The results indicate that the learners favored kinesthetic over auditory and visual learning styles. This aligns perfectly with the use of 4D printers, as explained in the previous literature. Thus, it may be concluded that the use of 4D printers could positively impact sustainability in education.
